|descr= Returns a unit's current weapon muzzle. Does not work on vehicles.

<sqf>_muzzle = weaponState unit select 1;</sqf>}}

|x1= <sqf>_muzzle = currentMuzzle player;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_muzzle = currentMuzzle (gunner (vehicle player));</sqf>
